posts.text:
Nepal Wire's take: Nepali Congress opened its 15th convention while the man who used to run it urged a boycott. Sher Bahadur Deuba, the former prime minister and former party president, has called for that boycott, Desh Sanchar reported. His own invitation never reached him either, co-general secretary Yogendra Chaudhary told OnlineKhabar. That one-sided account stands uncontested because none of the reports carries Deuba's side. Hotel bookings for roughly 10,000 delegates and well-wishers show the party can put on a spectacle. They do not show who actually takes part in Monday's nominations, or whether a pending Supreme Court review changes the Election Commission's January recognition of party president Gagan Thapa's committee.
